en.name: Hikvision DS-7608NI-K2 8-Channel NVR
en.shortDescription: 8-channel NVR supporting up to 4K recording, two SATA bays.
en.description:
## Hikvision DS-7608NI-K2

An 8-channel network video recorder supporting up to 8MP camera input and 4K HDMI output.

- 8 IP camera channels
- Two SATA bays, up to 16 TB each
- Smart search and mobile viewing via Hik-Connect

so.shortDescription: NVR 8-kanaal ah oo taageerta duubista 4K, leh laba meelood oo SATA ah.
so.description:
## Hikvision DS-7608NI-K2

Qalab duubista muuqaalka shabakadda ah oo 8-kanaal ah, taageerta gelinta kaamirad ilaa 8MP ah iyo bixinta HDMI 4K ah.

- 8 kanaal oo kaamirad IP ah
- Laba meelood oo SATA ah, mid kasta ilaa 16 TB
- Raadinta caqliga leh iyo daawasho mobile ah oo lagu maro Hik-Connect
